name: io.github.RuihongY/verdi-bridge
title: Verdi Bridge
description: Inspect waveforms and navigate RTL in live Synopsys Verdi. Requires a licensed Verdi installation.

environmentVariables.name: VERDI_BRIDGE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Private bridge session directory on the Verdi host, after loading bridge.tcl.

environmentVariables.name: VERDI_BRIDGE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SSH user@host; omit for a local Verdi GUI.

environmentVariables.name: VERDI_BRIDGE_CONTROL_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional existing SSH ControlMaster socket path.
